Maharashtra TET Scam: Wife of Alleged Mastermind Arrested, Probe Widens

Authorities have arrested the wife of the alleged mastermind in the Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) paper leak scam. Police stated she was aware of financial transactions within the multi-State racket. The arrest comes as the Special Investigation Team (SIT) intensifies its hunt for the absconding mastermind and widens its investigation across several states, following the postponement of the exam which affected over six lakh candidates.
